name: Untold Tales: A Scarlet Way
detailed_description:
Devil May Cry meets Little Red Riding Hood in this brutal isometric hack-and-slash. Unleash long aerial combos and seamless weapon swaps to slay angels, demons, and the Wolf in style – all to a pounding Metal & Dubstep soundtrack.

Explore a dark Victorian fantasy world as Scarlet (Red Riding Hood all grown up) on a quest to save Ba, in a story full of intrigue and twists. Unlock new moves (90+ combat animations!) across 3 distinct fighting styles, and carve your own path through hordes of enemies.

Fans of Devil May Cry, Bayonetta and Darksiders will feel right at home with A Scarlet Way’s fast, combo-heavy combat and atmospheric story.

Please note that the game is at an early stage of development.

Like what you see? Add A Scarlet Way to your Steam wishlist to be notified on release!

A NEW TAKE ON A CLASSIC FAIRYTALE

Step into the dark, brutal story of Scarlet — a grown-up Little Red Riding Hood armed with deadly melee weapons — and find out what kind of trouble Grandma’s in this time by slicing through anyone who stands in your way, in style.

VERTICAL COMBAT AND PLATFORMING — A FRESH TWIST ON THE GENRE

Take advantage of vertical gameplay: launch enemies into the air and finish them off from above. Chain platforming and combat together as you explore a layered, multi-tiered world.

FIGHT YOUR WAY

Scarlet’s arsenal includes 3 distinct melee weapon types, each with its own unique combat style. Switch between them seamlessly to cut down enemies to the sound of heavy music — your way, your rhythm.

STYLE MEETS POWER

Unlock new moves to expand your combo potential and boost the style and impact of your attacks — turning every encounter into a stylish, blood-soaked spectacle.
